dataset.name: SCORPION paired-scanner benchmark
dataset.important_boundary: SCORPION does not provide a validated biological-category label for these regions. These experiments therefore use tissue-region identity as the preserved target and must not be described as diagnostic-task validation.

representations.raw_dinov2: Frozen DINOv2-Base source features aligned to each registered fold.
representations.pa_nf_acquisition_descriptive: acquisition_features array from pathoalign_dep20 projected_features.npz; mechanism control only.

experiment_1_shortcut_susceptibility.question: When scanner identity is made spuriously predictive of a same-region matching label during downstream training, does the frozen PA-NF biological representation retain held-out matching performance better than raw DINOv2 and the equal-capacity two-branch control?
experiment_1_shortcut_susceptibility.task: Binary ordered-pair classification: same tissue region versus different tissue region from the same original slide.
experiment_1_shortcut_susceptibility.train_scope: Only non-test slides from the registered five-fold split.
experiment_1_shortcut_susceptibility.test_scope: Only held-out slides from the registered fold; test pair construction is scanner-balanced and independent of label.
experiment_1_shortcut_susceptibility.correlation_definition: For each projection seed, one preferred query scanner is assigned to positive pairs and a different preferred query scanner to negative pairs. At level c, the preferred scanner receives fraction c of query slots and the remaining four scanners share 1-c equally. c=0.2 is exactly uniform over five scanners; c=1.0 makes query scanner perfectly label-predictive in training.
experiment_1_shortcut_susceptibility.negative_pair: different region from the same slide, different scanner
experiment_1_shortcut_susceptibility.candidate_scanner_constraint: candidate scanner is always different from query scanner for both labels so same-scanner pair status cannot itself reveal the label
experiment_1_shortcut_susceptibility.primary_endpoint: held-out balanced accuracy at correlation level 1.0
secondary_endpoints: held-out balanced accuracy at every frozen correlation level
normalized trapezoidal area under the held-out balanced-accuracy curve

all_required: PA-NF minus capacity-control held-out balanced accuracy at c=1.0 has mean > 0 and hierarchical slide/seed bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0
PA-NF minus raw-DINOv2 held-out balanced accuracy at c=1.0 has mean > 0 and hierarchical slide/seed bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0
capacity-control performance drop minus PA-NF performance drop from c=0.2 to c=1.0 has mean > 0 and bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0
PA-NF baseline c=0.2 balanced accuracy is noninferior to the capacity control with lower 95% bound >= -0.02

experiment_2_adversarial_retrieval.question: When biological identity and acquisition identity directly conflict, does the PA-NF biological representation retrieve the correct tissue region across scanners instead of a wrong region from the same scanner?
experiment_2_adversarial_retrieval.query_set: Every held-out SCORPION image exactly once in its registered test fold.

candidate_set_per_query.correct_candidates: the other four scanner views of the same tissue region
candidate_set_per_query.shortcut_candidates: all different regions from the same original slide acquired on the query scanner

experiment_2_adversarial_retrieval.similarity: cosine similarity after row-wise L2 normalization
experiment_2_adversarial_retrieval.primary_endpoint: conflict top-1 accuracy: max cosine to any correct cross-scanner view exceeds max cosine to every wrong same-scanner region
secondary_endpoints: hard-negative margin = max(correct cross-scanner cosine) - max(wrong same-scanner cosine)
PA-NF biological versus PA-NF acquisition-branch conflict accuracy

all_required: PA-NF biological minus capacity-control biological conflict top-1 accuracy has mean > 0 and hierarchical slide/seed bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0
PA-NF biological minus raw-DINOv2 conflict top-1 accuracy has mean > 0 and bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0
PA-NF biological minus PA-NF acquisition-branch conflict top-1 accuracy has mean > 0 and bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0
PA-NF biological hard-negative margin has mean > 0 and bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0

inference.bootstrap: paired hierarchical bootstrap: resample the five frozen projection seeds with replacement, then resample the 48 original slides with replacement; preserve all within-slide query/pair rows
inference.unit_warning: Patch rows and region pairs are not treated as independent biological replicates.

prohibited_actions_after_freeze: No change to correlation levels, preferred-scanner rotations, pair counts, pair construction, downstream classifier, endpoints, margins, bootstrap design, comparator set, or success rules after outcome inspection.
No tuning on registered test slides.
No replacing region identity with an unsupported biological or diagnostic label.
If either primary gate fails, retain the failure and do not redefine the endpoint on the same outcomes.
claim_boundary: A passing result may support reduced acquisition-shortcut susceptibility and stronger acquisition-conflict tissue-identity retrieval on the registered SCORPION paired-scanner protocol. It does not establish diagnostic robustness, clinical utility, external-site generalization, pure biological disentanglement, or universal superiority.
